nodes.label: Fitzgerald Color Coding
nodes.rationale: Modified Fitzgerald Key assigns fixed colors per word category so motor planning pairs position with color cues.

nodes.label: Board Layout 2026-11
nodes.rationale: First page is a fixed 3x3 grid with blank empties preserving positions; Eat/Drink, Go, and Play navigate via goto to Eat and Drink, Place, and Play sub-pages so growth never shifts existing buttons.

nodes.label: Motor Planning
nodes.rationale: Hidden and empty items keep grid positions so vocabulary expansion never breaks muscle memory.

nodes.label: Word Item Schema
nodes.rationale: Schema fields cover display, pronunciation override, audio key override, navigation target, and animation wiring so data, speech, and rendering stay in one record.
